ycy export env
Export .env file contents as JSON
Usage:
  ycy export env [dir] [flags]
Flags:
  -e, --env	Environment name, skip interactive selection (e.g. local, prod)
  -h, --help	help for env
  --merge	Merge .env with the selected environment file
  -o, --out	Write output to file instead of stdout
  --log-format	Diagnostic format: text or json
  --log-level	Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
  --quiet	Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose	Enable debug diagnostics
